name: Manufacturing employment and real manufacturing value added

employmentTable.title: Employment by sex and economic activity -- ILO modelled estimates, Nov. 2025 (thousands)

employmentDefinition: Number of employed people in establishments whose principal activity is manufacturing (ISIC Rev. 4, section C). Employment includes wage and salaried work and self-employment. An annual change measures the net change in the number employed. Gross hires, separations, vacancies and full-time-equivalent positions are separate measures.
estimation: All employment observations belong to the November 2025 edition of the ILO modelled estimates. The ILO uses harmonized country data, statistical estimation, and projections where necessary. Its 2025 figures were prepared before the year ended. The two native observation-status values do not identify which individual estimates are projections.

employmentStatus.blank: No additional observation-status flag supplied. All numeric values are from the ILO modelled series.

join: Match geography and calendar year. Use exact publisher country codes except the verified Channel Islands alias (ILO CHA, WDI CHI). Preserve ILO-only ESH (Western Sahara) and TWN (Taiwan, China) as distinct areas with empty WDI fields. Retain WDI-only years and areas. Use the World Bank area name where available.
geography: Africa uses the UN M49 region 002 classification from the existing manufacturing output release. Native ILO country estimates can predate independence. Keep the reporting areas and time series as published, including Sudan and South Sudan. Historical borders, survey frames, classification revisions and coverage changes affect long-run comparisons.

calculation: Convert published thousands to persons by exact decimal multiplication by 1,000. Calculate manufacturing share as 100 times manufacturing employment divided by all employment, both for total sex and the same ISIC Rev. 4 table, source and year. Store derived shares at double precision. Preserve the published WDI CSV fields, decimals and status flags.
selection: Keep SEX_T and the two listed ISIC Rev. 4 categories. Omit all other sex and activity categories, including broader industrial employment. The alternative aggregate classification in the same source can differ slightly due to the published precision. The complete original indicator includes all categories and publisher groups.
missing: CSV blanks and JSON nulls in numeric fields indicate unavailable values. Require a positive denominator for shares and positive start values for percentage growth. Compare exact requested endpoints. No interpolation, nearest-year replacement or aggregation across geographies.
interpretation: Manufacturing output is value added in constant 2015 US dollars. Compare total real value added with persons employed. WDI national accounts and ILO labour estimates have distinct sources and may differ in their treatment of informal activity, industry classifications and country boundaries. Together their changes describe association.
validation: All 19,292 selected ILO geography/year/category cells, including the regional groups retained in the source archive, matched a separately downloaded official code-and-label response for exact decimal values, source IDs and observation flags. Explicit labels verified the indicator edition, unit, sex, both activity categories and status codes. WDI inputs match the hashes of the preserved output release.
